app.name: Skylanders Portal - Wii ONLY
app.long_description: For original Wii only, not Wii U vWii or Wii mini. Select SkylandersWii, base57 v5918, destination252. Tested on a European original Wii. Select cIOS revision 21999. Supports the shared600-figure SD library,16 portal slots and five matching game menu patches. Do not choose the separate vWii installer on an original Wii.
